epics.title: Local Docker Compose Environment
epics.jtbd: When a developer or tester runs the project locally, I want to be able to start the full stack via docker-compose and check its health, so that the product can be observed in a real running state.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of runtime starts succeed without missing docker-compose file errors
requirements: R1: The repository root must contain a valid docker-compose.yml file to allow successful project launch

slices.title: Add missing docker-compose.yml at repository root
slices.jtbd: When implementing the local docker-compose environment for this epic, I want to add the missing docker-compose.yml file, so that the product can launch successfully without file-not-found errors
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh clone of the repository
When a developer runs docker-compose up
Then the docker-compose.yml file is found and parsed
Given the docker-compose file is parsed
When the services start
Then all required infrastructure dependencies are initialized successfully
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 0 launch failures due to missing docker-compose.yml
